# uptimekuma_notification_bearsms (Resource)

BearSMS notification resource. The alert is sent as an SMS through the BearSMS gateway. Requires Uptime Kuma 2.5.1 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_bearsms" "example" {
  name         = "BearSMS Notifications"
  username     = "your-bearsms-username"
  hash_key     = "your-bearsms-hash-key"
  phone_number = "9725XXXXXXXX"
  is_active    = true
  is_default   = false
}

# Show an approved sender name to the recipient (at most 11 characters).
resource "uptimekuma_notification_bearsms" "with_sender" {
  name         = "BearSMS with sender"
  username     = "your-bearsms-username"
  hash_key     = "your-bearsms-hash-key"
  sender_id    = "UptimeKuma"
  phone_number = "9725XXXXXXXX"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: hash_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change hash_key_wo_version whenever the hash key changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_bearsms" "write_only" {
  name = "BearSMS with a write-only hash key"

  username     = "your-bearsms-username"
  phone_number = "9725XXXXXXXX"

  hash_key_wo         = "your-bearsms-hash-key"
  hash_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `phone_number` (String) The recipient phone number with country code and without a `+` or `00` prefix, for example `9725XXXXXXXX`.
- `username` (String) The BearSMS account username.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `hash_key` (String, Sensitive) The BearSMS hash key belonging to the account. Stored in state; use `hash_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `hash_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The BearSMS hash key belonging to the account, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `hash_key`; requires `hash_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `hash_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `hash_key` until the next apply with `hash_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `hash_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `hash_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `hash_key_wo`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `sender_id` (String) The sender name or number shown to the recipient, at most 11 characters. The sender has to be approved in the BearSMS account. The length limit mirrors the Uptime Kuma web UI; the server itself enforces neither. If unset, Uptime Kuma sends no sender with the request.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
